# Resource Processes

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this file for PM-30 through PM-34.

| ID | Process | Purpose | Inputs | Outputs | Tailoring | Check | Authority | PMI source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM-30 | Plan Resource Management | Define how team and physical resources will be estimated, acquired, led, and controlled. | Scope, schedule, organization, skills, policies, constraints | Resource approach, roles, responsibility model, acquisition and release rules | Use a simple responsibility record for small work; formal plan for distributed or scarce resources. | Roles, decision rights, capacity assumptions, and escalation route are visible. | Drafts plan; PM or functional authority confirms commitments. | 2.6.2.1 |
| PM-31 | Estimate Resources | Determine the type, quantity, timing, and capability of resources needed. | Scope structure, schedule, rates, skills, calendars, constraints | Resource estimate, capacity gap, assumptions, options | Use ranges and rolling estimates where work is uncertain. | Estimate ties to work and dates and identifies unavailable or constrained capability. | Prepares estimate; PM decides trade-offs and commitments. | 2.6.2.2 |
| PM-32 | Acquire Resources | Obtain the people, facilities, tools, or materials needed for delivery. | Resource plan, estimate, sourcing strategy, availability, approvals | Acquired resources, agreements, onboarding actions, unresolved gaps | Tailor procurement and onboarding to risk, scarcity, and organizational rules. | Acquisition has authority, timing, cost, acceptance, and fallback where needed. | Recommends and prepares; authorized manager or procurement owner commits. | 2.6.2.3 |
| PM-33 | Lead the Team | Support performance, collaboration, capability, and conflict resolution. | Team plan, roles, feedback, work data, risks, organizational context | Team actions, decisions, feedback records, learning, resolved or proposed conflicts | Match cadence and intervention to team maturity, distribution, and delivery approach. | Team conditions, decisions, blockers, and improvement actions are visible. | May facilitate and coach; PM decides role or performance actions. | 2.6.2.4 |
| PM-34 | Monitor and Control Resourcing | Compare resource needs and use with the plan and delivery forecast. | Resource plan, actual capacity, utilization, schedule, risks, changes | Resource variance, forecast, reallocations, proposed actions or changes | Monitor only material resources for small work; increase detail for scarce or regulated resources. | Resource variance explains delivery impact and has an authorized response path. | Recommends reallocation; PM or functional authority decides commitments. | 2.6.2.5 |
